summary: Updated existing m154 to saved published v3: five exhibition chapters and 4K plates, ten exploration destinations, regional buildings and provenance query, 24 reference images, two downloadable photogrammetry meshes and frame fallbacks. Original source and attribution preserved.

local.recheck_reason: The full local run passed all nine desktop groups, then a five-second mobile layout poll timed out under software rendering. Confirmed no horizontal overflow, increased the wait, repaired the visibly obstructed portrait palace view, and reran mobile/CPU checks. Public validation uses the complete suite.

Exhibition and survey controls work at 390/360 px and short landscape without horizontal overflow

package_release.reason: No new installer; source-side generation scripts archived. Actual GLB and OSM data downloads were checked by bytes and SHA-256.

limitations: Exhibition films are offline renderings, not real footage. Geographic data are snapshots and modeled heights are not surveyed measurements.
Two models remain original-author, opt-in online embeds. Their loading controls and original URLs were checked; third-party rendering and availability are not guaranteed.
All road collisions, sustained tour playback, every device frame rate and surveying accuracy are outside validation scope.
